follow-up time: > 3 months (for most participants) and > 6 months (for some participants)
exposure: Vaginal repair of cesarean section diverticulum (CSD)
outcome: Thickness of the remaining muscular layer (TRM)
cohort: 248 women with CSD who underwent vaginal repair surgery.
finding: Vaginal repair of CSD shortened the duration of menstruation and improved anatomical defects, with no significant difference in clinical effectiveness between women with one or two previous cesarean sections.
